data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'wtz' meaning 'to detach, to separate'. This name signifies one who is decisive, determined and strong-willed. The name Motaz carries the meaning “Determined, Decisive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Motaz usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, decisive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
